## Prohibited activities

- denial of service unless explicitly approved;
- destructive actions;
- uncontrolled propagation;
- testing third-party assets without authorization;
- collection of unnecessary sensitive data;
- any activity outside the stated scope.

Add organization-specific restrictions below.
